decisions.title: Components encode behavior contracts — not duplicate cards
decisions.decision: A component is justified when it standardizes interaction, accessibility, and state — not when it duplicates a slightly different card.
decisions.reason: Principle C-1 — Components exist to encode behavior contracts.

sections: C-1 — Components exist to encode behavior contracts
evidence.quote: A component is justified when it standardizes interaction, accessibility, and state — not when it duplicates a slightly different card.
Define how reusable components earn existence, behave, and relate — without styling recipes.

decisions.implementation_impact: Reject new shared components that only restyle cards. Require stated interaction/a11y/state contract.

decisions.title: Prefer primitives over snowflakes — extract on second demand
decisions.decision: If two pages need the same behavior, extract a primitive. If one page needs a one-off, keep it local until the second demand appears.
decisions.reason: Principle C-2 — Prefer primitives over page-specific snowflakes.

sections: C-2 — Prefer primitives over page-specific snowflakes
evidence.quote: If two pages need the same behavior, extract. If one page needs a one-off, keep it local until the second demand appears.

decisions.implementation_impact: No premature abstraction. Second consumer triggers extract. Document extract decisions in vault when contract-level.

decisions.title: One component owns a primitive — variants not parallel inventions
decisions.decision: One component owns each primitive. Examples: one Mood control family; one Confirm destructive pattern; one Capture input family. Variants are sizes/contexts, not parallel inventions.
decisions.reason: Principle C-3 — One component owns a primitive. Prevents identity fracture via duplicate primitives.

sections: C-3 — One component owns a primitive
evidence.quote: Examples: one Mood control family; one Confirm destructive pattern; one Capture input family. Variants are sizes/contexts, not parallel inventions.
AIIMIN’s debt includes duplicate primitives and lingering `window.confirm`.

decisions.implementation_impact: Audit and kill parallel Confirm/Mood/Capture inventions. New variants must extend owner, not fork.

decisions.title: Interactive component states are mandatory design work
decisions.decision: Every interactive component defines: default, hover/focus (as applicable), active, disabled, loading, error, empty, success. Missing states ship as bugs.
decisions.reason: Principle C-4 — States are mandatory design work.

sections: C-4 — States are mandatory design work
evidence.quote: Every interactive component defines: default, hover/focus (as applicable), active, disabled, loading, error, empty, success. Missing states ship as bugs.

decisions.implementation_impact: Component checklists include full state matrix. Missing state = bug, not polish backlog.

decisions.title: Composition over configuration explosion
decisions.decision: Prefer slots/composition to large boolean-prop matrices that recreate the universe.
decisions.reason: Principle C-5 — Composition over configuration explosion.

evidence.quote: Prefer slots/composition to 40 boolean props that recreate the universe.

decisions.implementation_impact: Reject mega-components with sprawling booleans. Prefer composable slots. Refactor when prop matrices explode.

decisions.title: Accessibility is part of the component API
decisions.decision: Focus management, labels, roles, and hit targets ship with the component — not as a consumer afterthought.
decisions.reason: Principle C-6 — Accessibility is part of the component API. Elevates GOV-133 into component-contract law.

sections: C-6 — Accessibility is part of the component API
evidence.quote: Focus management, labels, roles, hit targets ship with the component — not as a consumer afterthought.

decisions.implementation_impact: Component APIs include a11y affordances by default. Consumers must not re-implement labels/focus for basic use.

decisions.title: Capture components are sacred — no ceremony wrapping Enter-to-save
decisions.decision: CaptureBar / Logger / Palette routing components may not be wrapped in ceremony that slows Enter-to-save.
decisions.reason: Principle C-8 — Capture components are sacred.

evidence.quote: CaptureBar / Logger / Palette routing components may not be wrapped in ceremony that slows Enter-to-save.

decisions.implementation_impact: Ban ceremony wrappers around capture submit. Measure against Enter-to-save. Align with GOV-116 after-commit motion.

decisions.title: Read components stay calm — score, chart, digest do not demand input
decisions.decision: Score, chart, and digest components optimize scan and comprehension; they do not demand input.
decisions.reason: Principle C-9 — Read components stay calm.

evidence.quote: Score, chart, and digest components optimize scan and comprehension; they do not demand input.

decisions.implementation_impact: Read components: no forced input chrome. Separate capture/edit affordances from scan surfaces.

decisions.title: Navigation components obey locks — BrandLockup split and device-tier shells
decisions.decision: Navigation components obey product locks: BrandLockup split targets; device-tier nav shells (BottomNav / TabRail / Masthead) respect ceilings.
decisions.reason: Principle C-12 — Navigation components obey locks.

evidence.quote: BrandLockup split targets; device-tier nav shells (BottomNav / TabRail / Masthead) respect ceilings.

decisions.implementation_impact: Do not unify BrandLockup click targets. Shell components enforce /m vs desktop vs native ceilings. Depends on open GOV-012/075 ND — founder align.

decisions.title: No decorative AI components — intelligence via outcomes and chips
decisions.decision: Components named or styled to signify “AI” without behavior are banned. Intelligence appears as outcomes and chips, not badges.
decisions.reason: Principle C-13 — No decorative AI components.

evidence.quote: Components named or styled to signify “AI” without behavior are banned. Intelligence appears as outcomes and chips, not badges.

decisions.implementation_impact: Remove AI-glow badges without behavior. Prefer chips/outcomes. Ban idle AI identity chrome in component library.

decisions.title: Component versioning by contract — vault note when behavior defaults change
decisions.decision: Changing a component’s default behavior requires a vault/Bible note when it alters product contracts (e.g., confirm patterns, capture submit).

evidence.quote: Changing a component’s default behavior requires vault/Bible note when it alters product contracts (e.g., confirm patterns, capture submit).

decisions.implementation_impact: Contract-altering component PRs must update vault/Bible. Cosmetic-only changes do not require contract notes.
